scope: Final read-only review of journal Store plus helper owner/baseline/handoff integration; no runtime or QEMU acceptance claimed.
head: a484d116b7d6acbc80ec7d84ab76b25707838115
reviewer_authorship: Reviewer authored the initial journal.rs implementation. Root subsequently added the runtime byte checks, missing-lock rejection, required-driver deserialization, bus-zero guard and integration. This is not an independent implementation audit of the reviewer-authored initial Store.

checks.finding: Version 1, bounded records/interfaces and 16MiB input; strict nested schemas and typed validation reject corruption, duplicates and malformed identifiers.
driver is required even when its legitimate explicit value is null; omitted fields cannot silently establish an unbound original.
Explicit bus==0 rejection precedes unsigned minor arithmetic, including corrupted-input defense.
Directory-FD traversal rejects symlinks/parent escapes/untrusted ownership or write permissions; fixed regular 0600 one-link files use NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK.
Exclusive nonblocking flock is retained by Store; an existing final directory missing lock or journal is not silently initialized.
healthy compares known directory/lock/journal identity and bounded original journal bytes. Missing, replaced, truncated and same-inode modified content poison the Store.
Exclusive temporary creation, file sync, rename and directory sync precede cache installation. An uncertain write retains the old cache and refuses subsequent reads and mutations.
get, has_device and records return Result, so poison or backing-file uncertainty is not represented as absence or an empty authorization table.
open_physical awaits reserve before constructing a handoff for JSON/ancillary-FD delivery; uncertainty leaves the durable record unresolved.
Handoff fields declare grant before tracking, so the helper grant FD is dropped before tracking permits finish; finish independently waits for active handoff tracking.
Cooperative finish compares UID, PID, start_time and boot_id. Root reconciliation is a separate path and requires the original owner to have ended.
Capture and verify reobserve complete original configuration, interface/alternate/driver set and generation; gone handling never applies the saved baseline to replacement hardware.

current_product_slice.implemented_source_scope: Persistent unresolved authorization guard and cooperative finish / root read-only reconciliation.
current_product_slice.finish_meaning: Trusted original service declares its known capabilities finished; helper separately checks original full state before retiring management history. This is not proof that every possible delegated OFD reference disappeared.
current_product_slice.uncertainty: Pending/failed handoffs, unverified cleanup, corruption or uncertain durable writes remain fail-closed.
current_product_slice.external_admin_race: Read-only before/after observations do not linearize against concurrent privileged external sysfs/device mutations.

prior_design_research_not_implemented.retained_A: A helper-kept duplicate of the old USBFS OFD A can deliberately retain that old state. It is not independent recovery authority and child death does not close all references.
prior_design_research_not_implemented.independent_B: An independently opened USBFS OFD B has a separate kernel usb_dev_state; it cannot release or reap claims belonging to A.
prior_design_research_not_implemented.A_plus_B_candidate: A future limited recovery design could combine a controlled last-close boundary for A with independent B and write-ahead/acknowledged ownership/configuration history under an explicit trusted-worker/no-untracked-forwarding boundary. None of those automatic recovery actions are implemented or validated by this Store review.
prior_design_research_not_implemented.guardian_alternative: An ordinary guardian holding independent B was a design alternative, not a completed product path.
prior_design_research_not_implemented.limitations: PID death, DROP_PRIVILEGES, epoll HUP, dup/SCM_RIGHTS or CONNECT autoprobe alone do not prove capability retirement and restoration to the saved original driver.

execution_boundaries.root_reported_software_results_not_reexe: Parent reported development daemon 48 tests, backend 45 tests and CLI checks passed; full scripts/check.sh was in progress. This review does not independently attest those executions.
